branches.label: Thornguard
branches.description: Plants itself at the front and answers in kind. Trades reach for a heavier swing.

branches.label: Spore Weaver
branches.description: Works the whole field from the bench: longer vines, nothing to touch.

branches.label: Grove Keeper
branches.description: The bulb is a supply line, not a weapon. Softens whoever your Lead has to face.

branches.label: Titanvine
branches.description: The flower is a siege engine. Everything is heavy and everything is close.

branches.label: Sporelord
branches.description: Reach, and then more reach — up to the four-AP one nothing survives.

branches.label: Bloomwarden
branches.description: A standing garden: it drains, it heals, and it does not fall over.

branches.label: Emberfang
branches.description: Closes the distance and stays there.

branches.label: Cinderlash
branches.description: Never touches you. Sets the fight alight from the bench.

branches.label: Hearthkeeper
branches.description: Smoke becomes fire that does not go out: a Burn on demand, every turn.

branches.label: Drakewing
branches.description: Stops being a Fire type in a fight and starts being a dragon.

branches.label: Infernal
branches.description: Burns from altitude, and the four-AP one ends arguments.

branches.label: Updraft
branches.description: Keeps the fire on the enemy and the team on its feet.

species.name: Squirtle

branches.label: Shellbreaker

branches.label: Tidecaller
branches.description: Works at range and takes the fight out of whatever it hits.

branches.label: Tideguard
branches.description: Outlasts: armour that stacks and a regen that never stops.

branches.label: Hydrocannon

branches.label: Bulwark
branches.description: The shell belongs to the team now.

branches.label: Hardshell
branches.description: A cocoon that bites back, and comes off the bench to do it.

branches.label: Silkbinder
branches.description: Wraps the fight up instead of winning it.

branches.label: Ironshell
branches.description: Thickens until nothing gets through.

branches.label: Flutterblade
branches.description: Darts in, hits, and is back on the bench.

branches.label: Dustweaver
branches.description: Powder from everywhere, always landing.

branches.label: Wardwing
branches.description: Holds the team together while the powder does the work.

branches.label: Spearshell
branches.description: All the growth goes into the stingers. Fragile, and in a hurry about it.

branches.label: Venomweaver
branches.description: Poison first, damage second.

branches.label: Lancer
branches.description: Three stingers and no patience.

branches.label: Venomancer

branches.label: Talonstrike

branches.label: Windcaller
branches.description: Stays up and stays back.

branches.label: Downdraft
branches.description: Takes the strength out of whatever is swinging at your Lead.

branches.label: Skyreaver
branches.description: Comes down out of the sun, and does not much care what it costs.

branches.label: Galecaller
branches.description: Owns the air.

branches.label: Tailwind
branches.description: Draws the cards and heals the difference.

branches.label: Fangrunner
branches.description: Bites once, hard.

branches.label: Scavenger
branches.description: Fights dirty and never where you expect.

branches.label: Volt Tackle
branches.description: The quick jab becomes a full-body charge that burns some of its own tail on the way in.

branches.label: Storm Cheeks
branches.description: The shock grows into a bolt, and a thunderhead gathers behind it.

branches.label: Static Field
branches.description: The growl turns charming, and a discharge crackles over everything in front of it.

branches.label: Nightfang
branches.description: Feeds on the fight.

branches.label: Echolocator
branches.description: Never lands.

branches.label: Rootfeeder
branches.description: Takes what it needs from whatever it touches.

branches.label: Toxicbloom
branches.description: Stops pretending to be a Grass type.

branches.label: Mistpetal
branches.description: The scent is a shield.

branches.label: Toxicarium
branches.description: A walking bloom of poison.

branches.label: Petalstorm
branches.description: Drains the field and dances through it.

branches.label: Pollenguard
branches.description: The pollen heals what it drifts over.

species.name: Diglett

branches.label: Burrower
branches.description: Three heads, one direction: straight down, then straight up.

branches.label: Duststorm
branches.description: Never surfaces. Everything arrives as grit.

branches.label: Migraine
branches.description: The headache becomes the weapon.

branches.label: Placid

branches.label: Legend Hound
branches.description: The bite hardens into a crunch, and it learns the speed the old stories gave it.

branches.label: Firestorm
branches.description: The embers become a flamethrower, and the heat rolls over everything in front of it.

branches.label: Ripplefist
branches.description: Grows arms and immediately learns what to do with them.

branches.label: Mesmer
branches.description: The spiral does the work.

branches.label: Lullaby
branches.description: Puts the fight to sleep and takes its guard down on the way.

branches.label: Ironfist
branches.description: Pure forward pressure — and it hits harder for every scrape it is carrying.

branches.label: Bastion
branches.description: Learns to hold ground instead of taking it.

branches.label: Colossus
branches.description: Four arms, one plan.

branches.label: Bulwark
branches.description: Braces, then breaks whatever was counting on the Cleave.

branches.label: Snapjaw
branches.description: The wrap becomes a slam: it stops holding on and starts swinging.

branches.label: Cutting Leaves
branches.description: The vine sharpens into leaves it can throw from anywhere.

branches.label: Flytrap
branches.description: The slam becomes a whip, and a blade that always finds the soft part comes with it.

branches.label: Acid Pitcher
branches.description: The acid concentrates into sludge, and a storm of leaves it pays for afterwards.

branches.label: Man-o'-War
branches.description: The acid turns to sludge and the jet to a pulse: a long reach that poisons what it touches.

branches.label: Stinging Veil
branches.description: Confusion becomes a poison that worsens every turn, and the body goes to jelly.

branches.label: Boulderfist
branches.description: Picks itself up and throws itself.

branches.label: Stonecaster
branches.description: Reaches the bench the Lead cannot.

branches.label: Bedrock
branches.description: Becomes the wall: super-effective hits stop being the problem they were.

branches.label: Avalanche
branches.description: Rolls. Nothing in front of it stays standing.

branches.label: Quakebringer
branches.description: Hits the whole line at once, and then does it again.

branches.label: Bastion
branches.description: Sits down in the Lead slot and refuses to be a problem the team has to solve.

branches.label: Tri-Coil
branches.description: Three magnets, three elements: the shock becomes a bolt and the Tri Attack comes with it.

branches.label: Field Lock
branches.description: The hum grinds armour down, and the body locks itself into a wall.

branches.label: Tusk
branches.description: All the weight goes forward: a charge that costs it a little, and a tail that follows through.

branches.label: Floe
branches.description: The growl softens into a lullaby, and a nap on the ice puts it back together.

branches.label: Spike Shell
branches.description: The shell opens to fire its spikes: three icicles a card, and a punch behind the shard.

branches.label: Pearl Fortress
branches.description: Withdraw hardens into Iron Defense, and the aurora it sheds saps the hitter.

branches.label: The Pincer

branches.label: The Bulwark

branches.label: Ball Lightning
branches.description: Everything it has, all at once: the blast gets bigger and the tackle heavier.

branches.label: Capacitor
branches.description: It learns to hold the charge instead of spending it, and to let it go at everything in front of it.

branches.label: Miasma
branches.description: The smoke turns to poison, and the gas learns to burn as well.

branches.label: Detonator
branches.description: Two heads, one fuse: the blast gets bigger and the body behind it heavier.

branches.label: Riptide
branches.description: A sniper from the deep: the jet becomes a pulse and the dragon in it wakes up.

branches.label: Ink Cloud
branches.description: The ink blinds harder, and the tide quickens its shooters.

branches.label: Prism Core
branches.description: The core lights up: Swift becomes a psybeam, and a full Psychic follows it.

branches.label: Mender
branches.description: Harden becomes Recover, and the gem learns to confuse what it cannot outlast.

branches.label: Seaserpent
branches.description: The joke ends here. Everything that was flailing becomes a bite.

branches.label: Stormbringer
branches.description: Rises as weather, and opens with a Dragon the chart has no answer to.

branches.label: Flareon
branches.description: Fire. The heaviest Attack of the three, up close.

branches.label: Jolteon
branches.description: Electric. Fast, Ranged, and it paralyses from the bench.

branches.label: Vaporeon
branches.description: Water. The biggest HP pool in the Region, and it heals.
